    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static long[][] comb = new long[100][100];
    static ArrayList<Integer> q = new ArrayList<Integer>();
    static int head = 0;
    static HashMap<Integer, Node> best = new HashMap<Integer, Node>();

    static class Node {
        int dist;
        long count;
        Node(int d, long c) {
            dist = d;
            count = c;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (sc.nextInt() == 50) cnt50++;
            else cnt100++;
        }
        sc.close();

        int first = 1000000 + 100 * cnt50 + cnt100;
        best.put(first, new Node(0, 1));
        q.add(first);

        while (head < q.size()) {
            process(q.get(head++));
        }

        Node target = best.get(0);
        if (target != null) {
            System.out.println(target.dist + "\n" + target.count);
        } else {
            System.out.println("-1\n0");
        }
    }

    static void process(int mask) {
        int side = mask / 1000000;
        int left50 = (mask % 1000000) / 100;
        int left100 = mask % 100;
        int currentDist = best.get(mask).dist;

        if (side == 1) {
            for (int i = left50; i >= 0 && 50 * (left50 - i) <= k; i--) {
                for (int j = left100; j >= 0 && 50 * (left50 - i) + 100 * (left100 - j) <= k; j--) {
                    if (i != left50 || j != left100) {
                        long edgeWays = comb[left50][i] * comb[left100][j] % MOD;
                        int nxt = i * 100 + j;
                        addState(nxt, mask, edgeWays, currentDist + 1);
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int i = left50; i <= cnt50 && 50 * (i - left50) <= k; i++) {
                for (int j = left100; j <= cnt100 && 50 * (i - left50) + 100 * (j - left100) <= k; j++) {
                    if (i != left50 || j != left100) {
                        long edgeWays = comb[cnt50 - left50][i - left50] * comb[cnt100 - left100][j - left100] % MOD;
                        int nxt = 1000000 + i * 100 + j;
                        addState(nxt, mask, edgeWays, currentDist + 1);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void addState(int nxt, int mask, long edgeWays, int newDist) {
        if (!best.containsKey(nxt)) {
            best.put(nxt, new Node(newDist, 0));
            q.add(nxt);
        }
        Node current = best.get(mask);
        Node next = best.get(nxt);
        if (next.dist == newDist) {
            next.count = (next.count + current.count * edgeWays) % MOD;
        }
    }

    static void precomputeCombinations() {
        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
            comb[i][0] = 1;
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < 100; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                comb[i][j] = (comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j]) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }
}

    static class Item implements Comparable<Item> {
        int mask;
        int d;
        Item(int m, int d) {
            mask = m;
            d = d;
        }
        public int compareTo(Item o) {
            return Integer.compare(this.d, o.d);
        }

    public static void main(String[] args) {

        dist.put(start, 0);
        ways.put(start, 1L);
        pq.add(new Item(start, 0));

        while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
            Item cur = pq.poll();
            if (cur.d != dist.get(cur.mask)) continue;
            expand(cur.mask, dist, ways, pq);
        }

        if (dist.containsKey(0)) {
            System.out.println(dist.get(0) + "\n" + ways.get(0));
        } else {
            System.out.println("-1\n0");
        }
    }

    static void expand(int mask, Map<Integer, Integer> dist, Map<Integer, Long> ways, PriorityQueue<Item> pq) {
        int boat = mask / 1000000;
        int left50 = (mask % 1000000) / 100;
        int left100 = mask % 100;

        if (boat > 0) {
            for (int i = left50; i >= 0 && 50 * (left50 - i) <= k; i--) {
                for (int j = left100; j >= 0 && 50 * (left50 - i) + 100 * (left100 - j) <= k; j--) {
                    if (i != left50 || j != left100) {
                        long edge = comb[left50][i] * comb[left100][j] % MOD;
                        relax(mask, i * 100 + j, edge, dist, ways, pq);
                    }

            for (int i = left50; i <= cnt50 && 50 * (i - left50) <= k; i++) {
